topic: Asking the Travel Agent about a Tour for the Parents

script.title: A GIFT TRIP FOR PARENTS
script.scene_zh: 旅行社門市 · 替爸媽規畫行程
script.story_hook: One surprise trip, two parents, zero stress.
script.intro_zh: 一趟驚喜旅行，兩位爸媽，零壓力。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to today's travel agency desk. Listen for planning a trip.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今天的旅行社門市。留意規畫旅行的說法。
script.outro: The plan is set, the tea is brewing. Listen once more and repeat.
script.outro_zh: 行程底定，茶也準備好了。再聽一遍，跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's say each line again, together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們一起把每句再說一遍。
script.title_quote: my dad snores like a chainsaw
script.char_a_description: a well-dressed man in his mid thirties with a neat short fade haircut, thin wire glasses, a camel trench coat over a white shirt, leather gloves in hand, and a slim build
script.char_b_description: a warm woman in her fifties with chin-length straight silver hair, cat-eye glasses, a deep teal blazer over a cream blouse, a printed silk scarf, and a soft curvy build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, I'd like to ask about tours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔɹnɪŋ aɪd laɪk tə æsk əˈbaʊt taʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 早安，我想詢問旅行團的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, have a seat. Who's traveling?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs hæv ə sit huz ˈtɹævlɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，請坐。這次是誰要出門旅行？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My parents, a surprise gift from me.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpɛɹənts ə sɚˈpɹaɪz ɡɪft fɹʌm mi/
dialogue.zh: 是我爸媽，我送他們的驚喜禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's sweet. Any dream place they've mentioned?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts swit ˈɛni dɹim pleɪs ðeɪv ˈmɛnʃənd/
dialogue.zh: 真貼心。他們有沒有提過想去哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mom wants the coast, my dad likes cities.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ mɑm wɑnts ðə koʊst maɪ dæd laɪks ˈsɪtiz/
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽想看海，我爸爸喜歡逛城市。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, a coastal city tour, that's an easy match.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ə ˈkoʊstəl ˈsɪti taʊɹ ðæts ən ˈizi mætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那海岸城市遊覽正好兩全其美。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, they're in their seventies, so, easy pace.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt ðɛɹ ɪn ðɛɹ ˈsɛvəntiz soʊ ˈizi peɪs/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，他們七十多歲，步調一定要輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have one: half-day tours, full-day rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv wʌn hæf deɪ taʊɚz fʊl deɪ ɹɛst/
dialogue.zh: 我們剛好有一團：半天遊覽，整天休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, no sunrise bus departures, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd noʊ ˈsʌnˌɹaɪz bʌs dɪˈpɑɹtʃɚz pliz/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，拜託不要天沒亮就搭車出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one leaves at ten, coffee first, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn livz æt tɛn ˈkɑfi fɜɹst hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 這一團十點才發車，先喝咖啡再走，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's their speed exactly. How long's the trip?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðɛɹ spiːd ɪɡˈzæktli haʊ lɔŋz ðə tɹɪp/
dialogue.zh: 這正是他們喜歡的步調。行程總共幾天？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five days, two hotels, one overnight train.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv deɪz tu hoʊˈtɛlz wʌn ˌoʊvɚˈnaɪt tɹeɪn/
dialogue.zh: 五天，住兩間旅館，另有一段過夜火車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A train overnight? My dad talks about trains, um.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tɹeɪn ˌoʊvɚˈnaɪt maɪ dæd tɔks əˈbaʊt tɹeɪnz ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 過夜火車？我爸最愛聊火車了，嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then he'll love the sleeper cabin, doors lock too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hil lʌv ðə ˈsliːpəɹ ˈkæbən dɔɹz lɑk tu/
dialogue.zh: 那他會愛上臥鋪廂房，門還能上鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the walking distance small at every stop?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwɔkɪŋ ˈdɪstəns smɔl æt ˈɛvɹi stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 每個站點的步行距離都很短嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under a half mile, benches every block, seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ə hæf maɪl bɛntʃəz ˈɛvɹi blɑk ˈsɪɹiəsli/
dialogue.zh: 半哩以內，街上處處有座椅，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've met my mother's list, point by point.
dialogue.phonetic: /juv mɛt maɪ ˈmʌðəɹz lɪst pɔɪnt baɪ pɔɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 您完全命中我媽媽的清單，一項不差。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, parents ask the best questions, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈpɛɹənts æsk ðə bɛst ˈkwɛstʃənz ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，問問題最仔細的就是爸爸媽媽了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, the guide question: do they speak Chinese?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ɡaɪd ˈkwɛstʃən du ðeɪ spiːk ˌtʃaɪˈniz/
dialogue.zh: 再來是導遊，他們講中文嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The coast tour has a Mandarin-speaking guide, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə koʊst taʊɹ hæz ə ˈmændəɹin ˈspikɪŋ ɡaɪd jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 海岸線這一團就有中文導遊，是的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both languages? Or Chinese only on that bus?
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒəz ɔɹ ˌtʃaɪˈniz ˈoʊli ɑn ðæt bʌs/
dialogue.zh: 是雙語，還是那台車只講中文？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bilingual: day one English, day two Mandarin, switch.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪˈlɪŋɡwəl deɪ wʌn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ deɪ tu ˈmændəɹin swɪtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 雙語團：第一天英文，第二天中文，輪流來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their English is polite but quiet, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz pəˈlaɪt bʌt ˈkwaɪət hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 他們的英文很客氣，但也很安靜，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The guide repeats, slowly, twice, sometimes three times.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡaɪd ɹiˈpits ˈsloʊli twaɪs ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz θɹi taɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 導遊會重複，慢慢講，兩遍，有時三遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Is there an extra fee for that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt ɪz ðɛɹ ən ˈɛkstɹə fi fɚ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那要另外加錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing for the guide, but singles cost extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ fɚ ðə ɡaɪd bʌt ˈsɪŋɡəɹz kɔst ˈɛkstɹə/
dialogue.zh: 導遊不加價，但單人房要補差額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh right, my dad snores like a chainsaw.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɹaɪt maɪ dæd snɔɹz laɪk ə ˈtʃeɪnˌsɔ/
dialogue.zh: 對了，我爸打鼾像電鋸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many single rooms start with that exact sentence.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛni ˈsɪŋɡəɹ ɹumz stɑɹt wɪð ðæt ɪɡˈzækt ˈsɛntəns/
dialogue.zh: 很多單人房的要求，開頭就是這句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the single supplement per night?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə ˈsɪŋɡəɹ ˈsʌpləmənt pɜɹ naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 單人房每晚的差價是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty dollars, so two hundred extra for the trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹti ˈdɑləɹz soʊ tu ˈhʌndɹəd ˈɛkstɹə fɚ ðə tɹɪp/
dialogue.zh: 一晚四十元，整趟要多付二百元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My brother handles the money, I just book.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbɹʌðəɹ ˈhændəlz ðə ˈmʌni aɪ dʒʌst bʊk/
dialogue.zh: 錢歸我哥管，我只負責報名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's note it: twin beds, plus one single.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛts noʊt ɪt twɪn bɛdz plʌz wʌn ˈsɪŋɡəɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那就寫清楚：媽媽跟別人住雙床房，爸爸自己一間單人房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And insurance, is it included or separate?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪnˈʃʊɹəns ɪz ɪt ɪnˈkudɪd ɔɹ ˈsɛpəɹət/
dialogue.zh: 那保險呢，包含在團費裡還是另買？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Separate, honestly, I always push it for parents.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛpəɹət ˈɑnəstli aɪ ˈɔlweɪz pʊʃ ɪt fɚ ˈpɛɹənts/
dialogue.zh: 要另外買。老實說，替長輩我一定加保。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mom takes blood pressure pills, does that matter?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ mɑm teɪks blʌd ˈpɹɛʃəɹ pɪlz dʌz ðæt ˈmæɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽每天量血壓吃藥，這會影響投保嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Accidents, yes, routine care is not covered.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæksədənts jɛs ɹuˈtin kɛɹ ɪz nɑt ˈkʌvərd/
dialogue.zh: 意外事故可以理賠，日常看診不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So she should carry extra pills, got it.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʃi ʃʊd ˈkæɹi ˈɛkstɹə pɪlz ɡɑɾ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 所以她要多帶一些藥，我記下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And copies of prescriptions, customs loves paperwork.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈkɑpiz ʌv prɪˈskɹɪpʃənz ˈkʌstəmz lʌvz ˈpɛpəɹwæk/
dialogue.zh: 處方箋也帶副本，海關很愛查文件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Insurance price, roughly? It's per person?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈʃʊɹəns praɪs ˈɹʌfli ɪts pɜɹ ˈpɜɹsən/
dialogue.zh: 保險大概多少？是按人計算嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty a person, plus ten for the age band.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti ə ˈpɜɹsən plʌz tɛn fɚ ði eɪdʒ bænd/
dialogue.zh: 一人六十元，年滿七十再加十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheap money for big peace of mind.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃip ˈmʌni fɚ bɪɡ pis ʌv maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 花小錢買大安心，很划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That line sells itself, I hear it weekly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt laɪn sɛlz aɪtˈsɛlf aɪ hɪɹ ɪt ˈwikli/
dialogue.zh: 這句話就是最佳廣告，我每個禮拜都聽到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When's the last day I can book?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛnz ðə læst deɪ aɪ kæn bʊk/
dialogue.zh: 最晚哪一天要完成報名？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: October ninth, but the good hotels fill fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑkˈtoʊbɚ naɪnθ bʌt ðə ɡʊd hoʊˈtɛlz fɪl fæst/
dialogue.zh: 十月九日截止，但好旅館一下就訂滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, send me the full itinerary by email?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ sɛnd mi ðə fʊl aɪˈtɪnəˌɹɛɹi baɪ ˈimeɪl/
dialogue.zh: 好，可以把完整行程表傳給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus a packing list for senior travelers.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs plʌz ə ˈpækɪŋ lɪst fɚ ˈsinjɚ ˈtɹævləɹz/
dialogue.zh: 可以，還附上一份長輩打包清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That list alone will calm my whole family.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt lɪst əˈloʊn wil kɑm maɪ hoʊl ˈfæməli/
dialogue.zh: 光是那份清單就能讓全家安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A deposit of one hundred each holds the seats.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dɪˈpɑzɪt ʌv wʌn ˈhʌndɹəd itʃ hoʊldz ðə sits/
dialogue.zh: 每人訂金一百元，就能留住位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card, online, or should I come back here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd ɑnˈlaɪn ɔɹ ʃʊd aɪ kʌm bæk hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡、線上繳費，還是我再跑一趟？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The online link is easiest, I'll text it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɑnˈlaɪn lɪŋk ɪz ˈiziəst aɪl tɛkst ɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 線上連結最方便，我現在就傳給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My parents will ask fifty more questions, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpɛɹənts wil æsk ˈfɪfti mɔɹ ˈkwɛstʃənz ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 我爸媽肯定還會再問五十個問題，先說抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring them Tuesday, I'll brew a big pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðɛm ˈtuzdeɪ aɪl bɹu ə bɪɡ pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 星期二帶他們過來，我煮一大壺茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They'd love that, tea solves everything in our house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪd lʌv ðæt ti sɑlvz ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ ɪn ɑʊɹ haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 他們會很開心，茶是我們家的萬靈丹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And tell your dad the sleeper cabin rocks gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd tɛl jɔɹ dæd ðə ˈsliːpəɹ ˈkæbən ɹɑks ˈdʒɛntli/
dialogue.zh: 也告訴我爸爸，臥鋪會輕輕地搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He'll sign up himself just for that, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hil saɪn ʌp hɑɪmˈsɛlf dʒʌst fɚ ðæt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，光這一點他就會自己報名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All men dream of trains at seventy, no joke.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl mɛn dɹim ʌv tɹeɪnz æt ˈsɛvənti noʊ dʒoʊk/
dialogue.zh: 男人一到七十歲，個個都夢想搭火車，不騙你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, you've turned my worry into a plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju juv tɜrnd maɪ ˈwɜɹi ˈɪntu ə plæn/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，你把我的擔心變成了一份計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the job, safe travels for mom and dad.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə dʒɑb seɪf ˈtɹævəlz fɚ mɑm ænd dæd/
dialogue.zh: 這就是我的工作，祝伯父伯母一路平安。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you Tuesday with them, coffee's on me.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ˈtuzdeɪ wɪð ðɛm ˈkɔfiz ɑn mi/
dialogue.zh: 星期二我帶他們來，咖啡我請。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring your parents, I'll bring the printed maps.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ jɔɹ ˈpɛɹənts aɪl brɪŋ ðə ˈpɹɪnɪtɪd mæps/
dialogue.zh: 帶上爸媽，我來準備列印好的地圖。

script.youtube_title: 【替爸媽訂旅行團🧳】「我爸打鼾像電鋸」教你問步調、中文導遊、保險加購🚌🎧｜聽完就會規畫旅行｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Booking a Tour for My Parents
script.youtube_title_en: My Dad Snores Like a Chainsaw — Booking an Easy Pace Tour for My Parents
script.youtube_description:
「我爸打鼾像電鋸」——想替七十歲的爸媽報一個輕鬆的旅行團，該問的問題，你都想到了嗎？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在週末的旅行社門市櫃台。

你會聽到：描述長輩的需求、確認半天遊覽的輕鬆步調、追問中文導遊與雙語輪流；算清單人房差價、加購旅遊保險、確認處方藥與海關文件；還有訂金、線上繳費、約好帶爸媽來喝茶報名的完整對話。

全篇使用 A2 初級單字與短句，充滿諮詢時的真實語感：um、oh、ha、you know、got it。聽完你就會用：Who's traveling、How much is the single supplement per night、Is it included or separate、When's the last day I can book。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著念，先讓舌頭熟起來，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"My dad snores like a chainsaw" — how do you book an easy-pace tour for parents in their seventies without missing a single detail? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice at a travel agency desk.

You will hear: describing family needs, checking half-day schedules and easy morning starts, asking for a Mandarin-speaking guide; comparing the single-room supplement, adding travel insurance for blood-pressure meds, and customs paperwork; plus deposits, online links, and setting up a family visit.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with real planning rhythm: um, oh, ha, you know, got it. By the end you'll own lines like Who's traveling, How much is the single supplement, Is it included or separate, and When's the last day I can book.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.
